page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. No marginal notes. Small marks at the foot and along the edges are not printed text.

main_text.l: generis noftri, matrimonium fcilicet conta-
minat: pallium matris Domini inquinat, sub
quo occultat eft cœleftis partus: delectatio
nem vilium & turpium membrorum, deliti-
is, quæ in Deo funt, præponit: angelos Dei
triftitia afficit: hoftes Dei, id eft, dæmones ex
hilarat, quia vident in adulterio hominis
& animam, & corpus maculari.
Quarto Iofeph non ebrietati, fed fobrieta-
ti ftuduit. Nunquam enim ebrium putabo
caftum, inquit Hieronymus. Item alius:

l.i: Et Venus in vinis, ignū in igne furit.

main_text.l: Iofeph igitur non cognouit cum domino
fuo quicquam nifi panem, quem ipse come-
debat, hoc eft, ficut Rabi Abraham Sephar-
di exponit, Iofeph nihil ex cibis domini fui
cognouit, præter panem ficcum quo vesce-
batur, & tamen habuit vultum elegantem: si-
cut & Daniel abftinens à regis cibis, vesce-
batur leguminibus, & interim erat corpulen-
tior & pulchrior iliis, qui regijs nutrieban-
tur cibis. Vel, ficut alius ex doctioribus He-
bræorum explicat: omnia curabat præter ci-
bum domini fui, quod alijs cibis vteretur Io-
feph, alijs dominus eius. panis enim pro o-
mni ciborum genere, apud Hebræos fre-
quenter capitur.
Quinto, non folum verbis adulteræ obe-
dire recusauit, sed etiam eius cosuetudinem
declinauit: tantum abfuit, vt oculos fuos in
ipsam conuerterit. In [?] continentiæ enim præ-
paratione

page.notes: Page number read as 116 but the second digit is uncertain; could be 126. "In" at the start of the sentence after "conuerterit." is hard to read and may be "Ia" or "In". "ignū" carries a tilde that is hard to resolve; possibly "ignis" as printed. Printed oddities kept as they stand: "iliis", "regijs", "alijs", "conta-minat". Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The small mark at the bottom centre is not printed text and is left out.
